title: 1.2.30 Video — Every Value Has a Type
description: A four-minute tour of the whole type system: eight basic types, seven of them primitive, dynamic typing, and the typeof operator — including the one answer typeof gets wrong. Watch after the readings as a second pass over the same ground.
